limitations: One Linux VM, warm cache, short direct in-process reads in separate fresh processes. The read-only historical view holds a shared lock and does not validate or replay the tail; the writable store does. The fixture has no tail. RSS is Linux process RSS and excludes OS page cache; it is not a memory quota. VM/cgroup noise includes the workload. This is not a production or competitor comparison. The first harness sampled VmHWM after dropping the opened object; this reported value can be lower than the earlier RSS sample and must not be used as a peak-memory measurement. RSS-at-open and operation times were sampled while open.
